Weight.title: Weight-loss Plan and Progress
Weight.intro: Your personal plan, biweekly targets, and weekly body metrics in one place. Signed-in changes are saved and publicly visible.
Weight.healthTitle: Protect your health before chasing speed
Weight.healthBody: At the current weight, 1,300-1,400 kcal is an aggressive target. A commonly recommended gradual pace is about 0.45-0.9 kg per week. If loss stays much faster for several weeks, or dizziness, palpitations, shaking, weak legs, poor sleep, or waking hungry occurs, increase intake and consider speaking with a physician or registered dietitian.
Weight.healthSource: Read the CDC guidance on gradual weight loss

Roadmap.routeIntro_title: Graduate roadmap for robotics systems software
Roadmap.routeIntro_summary: Focus on robotics systems software, progressing through capability expansion, stabilization, measured bottlenecks, and targeted technology adoption. Complete Cyber AMR in year one, then Cyber Arm, and build a stable, measurable, recoverable Cyber Mobile Manipulator in year two.
Roadmap.routeIntro_mainTrack: Cyber AMR → Cyber Arm → Cyber Mobile Manipulator: STM32 / FreeRTOS → C++23 / Linux → ROS 2 / ros2_control → state estimation and autonomous navigation → MoveIt 2 / RGB-D → mobile manipulation and task recovery
Roadmap.routeIntro_sideTrack: Industrial real-time and motion-control foundations: real-time Linux → EtherCAT → CiA 402 → trajectory planning → single-axis servo control and fault safety. Develop supporting capabilities without creating another project of equal scale.
Roadmap.routeIntro_researchTrack: Research on a physical mobile manipulator: prioritize vision-based station alignment and grasp compensation under navigation error; alternatives include multisensor localization and robust navigation in degraded or dynamic environments. Ultimately investigate one central problem in depth.
Roadmap.routeIntro_finalGoal: Develop an integrated robotics skill set spanning embedded firmware, Linux C++ drivers, ROS 2, localization, navigation, manipulation, and task execution. Final results must include hardware demonstrations, repeated trials, quantitative metrics, failure analysis, automatic recovery, complete documentation, and research findings.
